_comment: Snack Time topics. Each day a few are offered (see SnackTime). A topic has an id, a menu title, an optional min_level (affection level needed), and steps in the Conversation format (see mood_checkin.json).

steps.say: If I could only eat one snack forever... it'd be strawberry shortcake.
What about you? Sweet or salty?
A fellow sweet tooth! I knew we'd get along.
Chips and crackers? Okay, I'll share mine if you share yours.
Salted caramel?! You're a genius.
Do you like rainy days?
I like listening to the rain on the window...
Right? Tea, a blanket, rain sounds... perfect.
Then I'll be your sunshine on rainy days!
People always ask about my ears.
Yes, they're real. Yes, they twitch when I'm happy. Don't stare!
...You can pat them sometimes, though.
Hehe. Rub the top of my head, then~
C-cute?! ...Thank you.
I love running. The wind in my hair, my tail flying behind me...
Sitting on your desktop all day makes my legs restless!
Do you exercise?
Wow, respect! Let's race someday.
Sometimes is still something. Keep it up!

choices.text: Does walking to the fridge count?

steps.say: ...It counts a little. Hehe.
Last night I dreamt I was a giant, sitting on top of your monitor.
You kept typing and I kept falling off the title bar!
Do you remember your dreams?
Then tell me the weird ones. I collect them.
Maybe I'll show up in one. Watch out~
Do you like my hair flower? It's a rose. Well, a rose and a little sunflower.
The rose is for being brave, and the sunflower is for being cheerful.
What flower would you be?
Bright and always facing the sun. That suits you!
Prickly outside, pretty inside? Hehe, I can see it.
A rare flower... I'd take good care of it.
You work a lot on this computer, huh?
My trick for focusing: work a little, then reward yourself with a snack.
Like right now! See, it works.
Can I tell you something? When I first got here, I was a little nervous.
Big windows everywhere, the taskbar rumbling...
But now it kind of feels like home.
Hey... do you ever think about how we met?
You just opened this program one day, and there I was.
Hehe... mine too.
Fate, huh? I like that.
Okay, a secret. But you can't tell anyone.
When you're not looking, I practise my victory pose on the taskbar.
Don't laugh! ...Fine, you can laugh a little.
